summary: An employer withholds federal income tax from each paycheck, based on the form the new employee fills out.
realLife: Employers generally must withhold federal income tax from employees' wages, based on the employee's Form W-4 and the IRS withholding tables.
sources: Internal Revenue Service, Understanding employment taxes: https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/understanding-employment-taxes
